quests.title: Welcome to Clover Village
quests.description: Carry Pip's welcome letter to Biscuit at the café for its first stamp.

lines: Every new courier carries the village welcome letter. It is not official until Clover Village has signed it.
Take it to Biscuit at the café. He stamps it, and he sends you on to the next villager.
A welcome letter, and still warm from the post office. Let me be the first stamp.
There. Maple is next — she keeps her stamp in the flower garden.

quests.title: Biscuit's Café Stamp
quests.description: Take the stamped welcome letter on to Maple in the flower garden.

lines: One stamp down. Mind the ink, and mind the crumbs — my counter is not gentle.
Maple is in the flower garden. She will want to read the letter before she signs it.
A letter from the whole village! I will add my stamp in moonflower ink.
Lumi should sign it too. She is at the research garden, past the flowering path.

quests.title: Maple's Flower Stamp
quests.description: Carry the fragile welcome letter carefully to Lumi at the research garden.

lines: Here it is again, one stamp richer. The paper is soft, so keep it flat and dry.
Lumi studies everything, postmarks included. Take it to her research garden.
A welcome letter, read from top to bottom — twice. My stamp goes right here.
Moss holds the last one. He is south of the plaza, watering the garden.

quests.title: Lumi's Research Stamp
quests.description: Take the welcome letter to Moss in the south garden.

lines: Three stamps already. This letter has travelled further than most of my studies.
Moss is watering the south garden. Tell him the post office sent you and he will stamp it.
So this is the famous welcome letter. Let me press my stamp on straight.
That is every villager who signs. Take it home to Pip at the post office.

quests.title: The Last Stamp: Back to Pip
quests.description: Return the fully stamped welcome letter to Pip at the post office.

lines: Signed and stamped by everyone but the postmaster himself.
Take it home to Pip. A letter is not finished until it comes back to where it started.
Pip, Biscuit, Maple, Lumi, Moss... every stamp in Clover Village, all on one letter.
By the authority of the Clover Post Office, you are now an official Courier!
The wider forest is waiting, Courier. Your next adventure starts whenever you are ready.

quests.title: A Warm Letter for Maple
quests.description: Deliver a letter from Pip to Maple at the flower field.

lines: A sealed letter for Maple — wax paw print and everything! Very official, very important.
Straight to the flower field, please. Maple gets flustered when the post runs late.
Oh! A letter, for me? Thank you for carrying it so gently.
I will read it among the tulips, where nobody can see me blush.

quests.title: The Lost Pebble
quests.description: Moss lost his favorite polished pebble near the rabbit burrows. Find it and return it.

lines: My favorite pebble has gone missing. It is smooth, silver, and very good at hiding.
Could you search around the rabbit burrows? The rabbits may have mistaken it for a snack.
There it is! My little moon-pebble.
You noticed what mattered to me. That is what friends do.

quests.title: Strawberry Basket for the Post Office
quests.description: Gather three strawberries for the post office pantry. Happy Valley's meadow hares guard the best patches.

lines: The post office pantry is empty, and a hungry postmaster sorts letters crooked!
The meadow hares in Happy Valley guard the best strawberry patches. Bring me three, quick as you can!
Three strawberries, perfectly sorted! You would make a fine postmaster.
One for me, one for the pantry, and one for the next courier through the door.

quests.title: Letters to the Clearing
quests.description: A multi-stop run: stop by Biscuit's picnic corner with the sealed letter, then deliver it to Maple.

lines: Two stops on one route — now that is real courier work!
Let Biscuit add his note at the picnic corner, then carry the letter on to Maple.
Biscuit's note is on the back — he drew a little honey pot.
Two stops and not a single crease. You really are a careful courier.

quests.title: A Moonflower for the Moth
quests.description: Search the pond edge for a rare moonflower and bring it to Lumi for her moonlight research.

lines: Moonflowers open only when the pond is still and the light is silver.
One grows at the pond edge. Search there, and bring it to me before it closes.
It is still glowing... the petals remember the moon.
My research thanks you. So do I, quietly.

quests.title: Herbs for the Café
quests.description: Gather two wild herbs for Biscuit's famous tea. The forest deer of Happy Valley graze through the herb patches.

lines: My famous tea needs two wild herbs, and my tin is down to crumbs!
The forest deer in Happy Valley graze right through the herb patches. Bring me two sprigs and the first pot is yours.
Smell that! The café will be cozy all afternoon.
Sit down, friend. The kettle is already singing.

quests.title: Lumi's Lost Notebook
quests.description: Lumi dropped her notebook by the pond. Find it and bring it back.

lines: My notebook slipped from my satchel near the pond. Every page has months of moonlight observations.
Please search the pond edge. The water is patient, but paper is not.
You found it before the ink ran. I can breathe again.
I will show you the next constellation I discover. That is a promise.

quests.title: Parcel for the Postmaster
quests.description: Maple sent a parcel to Pip. Deliver it to the post office counter.

lines: Could you take this little parcel to Pip? It is pressed flowers for the post office window.
Please don't tell him they're from me until he opens it.
A parcel from Maple! Pressed flowers for the window? Oh, she is too kind!
Filed under 'wonderful', delivered by the best courier in Clover Village.

quests.title: River Shells for the Window
quests.description: Search by the Happy Valley pond sign for three river shells for Biscuit's window shelf.

lines: My window shelf looks bare without a few river shells.
The pond in Happy Valley has the smoothest ones, right by the sign. Three would be perfect!
Look how they shine in the window! The café feels brand new.
Every customer is going to ask where these came from. I'll tell them all about you.

quests.title: A Picnic for the Florist
quests.description: Deliver Biscuit's warm picnic basket to Maple at the flower field before the food cools.

quests.title: The Golden Acorn
quests.description: The legendary golden acorn rests in the hollow oak. Retrieve it for Moss at the burrows.

lines: Mm... you kept the burrows and the garden safe, so I can tell you a secret.
The golden acorn sleeps in the hollow oak. Bring it here... slowly. It is very old.
The golden acorn... it is warmer than I remembered.
I will plant it where the whole village can watch it grow. Thank you, friend.

quests.title: Pip's Missing Letter Opener
quests.description: Pip misplaced his favorite letter opener somewhere near the counter. Find it and bring it back.

lines: My brass letter opener is missing! It has a paw-print handle and a very important job.
Search behind the counter, would you? I cannot open a single letter without it.
My letter opener! Safe and sound.
You are becoming the sort of courier a post office can always count on.

quests.title: Ingredients for the Café
quests.description: Biscuit is out of blueberries for his famous pastries. Gather three from the Happy Valley bushes.

lines: The café is ready for a baking day, but my blueberry basket is empty.
Gather three ripe berries from the valley bushes and I will make you the first taste-test.
Perfect berries! The ovens are singing already.
Save room, friend. The first pastry from this batch has your name on it.

quests.title: A Cap for the Best Courier
quests.description: Pip sewed a special courier cap to thank the forest's most trusted friend.

quests.title: A Crown of Wildflowers
quests.description: Maple wove a flower crown as a gift for her best friend in the whole forest.

quests.title: Biscuit's Golden Honey
quests.description: Biscuit saved his most precious jar of golden honey for a true friend.

quests.title: The Seed of a New Story
quests.description: Lumi entrusts you with a moonlit seed — the beginning of a story yet to bloom.

quests.title: The Hidden Garden
quests.description: Moss trusts you with the key to a secret garden plot he keeps behind the burrows.

quests.title: Boars at the Burrows
quests.description: Wild boars from Happy Valley keep trampling toward Moss's burrows. Defeat four of them, then report back to Moss.

lines: Mmh... the wild boars in Happy Valley keep trampling toward my burrows. The rabbits cannot sleep. Neither can I.
Could you chase off four of them? Then come and tell me, so I can finally nap.
Four boars, and the burrows are quiet again... *yawn*... thank you.
The rabbits left you a clover. I think that means you are family now.

quests.title: Fox Watch
quests.description: Valley foxes have been sneaking into Moss's garden beds at night. Defeat four in Happy Valley, then report back to Moss.

lines: Something has been digging up my seedlings at night... fox paw prints, everywhere.
Four valley foxes should teach the rest to stay in the valley. I will be here. Probably asleep.
No new paw prints this morning. My seedlings are standing tall.
You look after my garden like it is your own. I have one more secret to share... when you are ready.

quests.title: Hides for New Satchels
quests.description: Pip is stitching sturdy satchels for couriers crossing Happy Valley. Bring him three boar hides.

lines: Couriers keep coming back from Happy Valley with torn satchels! Unacceptable. Unorganized!
Boar hide is the toughest leather there is. Bring me three and I will start stitching tonight.
Three hides! Tough, thick, and very nearly satchel-shaped already.
Next I need quills to write the route cards. Come and see me when you are ready!

quests.title: Feathers for Route Quills
quests.description: Pip needs fresh quills to write safe-route cards for Happy Valley. Bring him three grouse feathers.

lines: Every satchel gets a route card, and every route card needs a good quill!
Black grouse feathers write the smoothest lines. Three should do it!
Look at these quills — the route cards practically write themselves!
One last thing: Biscuit worries about couriers on the valley roads. Let us tell him the good news.

quests.title: Safe Roads Through Happy Valley
quests.description: The satchels are stitched and the route cards written. Tell Biscuit the valley roads are safe for couriers again.

lines: Satchels stitched, route cards written — the valley roads are officially safe!
Go and tell Biscuit. He has been packing extra snacks for every courier, just in case.
The roads are safe? That is the best news I have had all season!
Here — a jar of forest honey, for the courier who made it happen.

quests.title: Lumi's Moonlight Survey
quests.description: Black grouse keep scattering Lumi's moonlight markers in Happy Valley. Defeat three, then report back to Lumi.

lines: The black grouse in Happy Valley keep scattering my moonlight markers. My survey cannot begin while they do.
Drive off three of them, then come back. I will be counting stars until you return.
The markers stand undisturbed tonight. The survey can finally begin.
Next I must study something the moon leaves behind... deer antlers catch its light, you know.

quests.title: An Antler Under Moonlight
quests.description: Lumi wants to study how moonlight settles on a forest deer's antler. Bring her one deer antler.

lines: Forest deer shed their antlers where the moonlight pools. I want to know why.
Bring me one antler from Happy Valley. Carefully... it is a quiet kind of treasure.
See how it glows along the ridges? The moon has been writing on it.
My findings are nearly complete. Someone else should read them first.

quests.title: Findings for the Florist
quests.description: Lumi sealed her moonlight survey for Maple, whose moonflowers began the research. Deliver the letter to Maple.

lines: Maple's moonflowers were where all of this began. She should read my findings first.
The letter is sealed. Take it to her at the flower field.
Lumi wrote this... about my moonflowers? I did not think anyone noticed them.
I need a moment. Please come back and see me soon.

quests.title: Maple's Moonflower Thanks
quests.description: Maple wants to thank the courier who carried Lumi's findings to her flower field.

lines: I read Lumi's letter three times. It made me feel a little braver.
I have something for you... could you stay a moment?
I knitted this scarf while the moonflowers were blooming. It is a little lopsided.
The nights are getting cooler. I would like you to stay warm on your routes.
